about_the_game:
• Lead & Blood is a fast-paced arena shoot 'em up with a dark and eerie atmosphere. Take control of a bloodthirsty huntress, ready to tear cultists apart in a secluded forest clearing.

Relentless Violence. No Breaks.

  • Endless hordes of enemies close in from all sides.

  • Dodge fireballs and other brutal attacks.

  • Collect hourglasses scattered across the map to extend your survival.

  • Strategically use your arsenal to take down the cultists.

Cultist Squad with Unique AI Behaviors

  • Each enemy has unique attack and movement patterns.

  • Enemies can be hit by bullets you deflect back at them.

  • Summoners: shoot fireballs from a distance with varied patterns.

  • Runners: charge at high speed to perform melee attacks, constantly trying to get close.

Content included in this Lead & Blood demo:

  • One playable character

  • Two available weapons: a baseball bat and a shotgun

  • Five different types of cultist enemies

  • Scoring system to challenge your reflexes

  • Six unlockable items visible in the "Collection" room

  • Intense action in an isolated forest clearing

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 ou AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7850 / Mesa Drivers compatíveis
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: A fast-paced arena shoot 'em up arcade. Face endless hordes in a dark forest, shoot everything that moves, dodge projectiles, deflect fireballs, and slice cultists. Master your weapons, and chase the highest score!
